name: Data Count
description: Counts existing nodes and users on the site for administrators.
project_description:
A statistical module, it helps admin to count all existing nodes and users data on the website. Admin can easily monitor the status of published/unpublished nodes and active/inactive users through given links respectively.

 Further, it provides the number of published/unpublished nodes in each content type and the number of valued active/inactive users based on assigned roles so such details can be useful in content audits.

 Features 
 This module is for stats which gives a detailed count overview of web content and user data.

 Reasons to use 
 
 Quick content audits 
 Clean admin interface 
 Lightweight and fast 
 No configuration or Views required 
 Useful for small and large websites 
 
 Steps to use 
 
 Install & enable the module as usual. 
 Go to the admin page "Reports >> Data Count" to view results. 
 The page shows the content type wise count under "Node Count Details" tab. 
 Similarly, there is the user role wise count under "User Count Details" tab. 
 
 Additional requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.
